gloss: to feel ashamed, to feel awkward

definitions.gloss: to feel ashamed, embarrassed, or awkward
definitions.explanation: Describes feeling uncomfortable or unable to hold one's head high, often due to circumstances beyond one's control or the actions of someone close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こして→起こす：01234_okosu⟧{肩身|かたみ}が{狭|せま}い。
examples.english: I feel ashamed because my son caused trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肩身|かたみ}が{狭|せま}い。
examples.english: Being unemployed, I feel awkward around my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喫煙者|きつえんしゃ}→喫煙者：27918_kitsuensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{肩身|かたみ}が{狭|せま}く⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Smokers have come to feel more uncomfortable in public these days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{肩身|かたみ}が{狭|せま}い。
examples.english: I'm in debt, so I feel awkward even in front of my friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{高卒|こうそつ}→高卒：19284_kousotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肩身|かたみ}が{狭|せま}い⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone around me is a college graduate, so being only a high school graduate makes me feel out of place.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {肩身|かたみ} (one's standing/position, literally 'shoulder-body') + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ (narrow). The image is of hunching one's shoulders to take up less space.

NUANCE: Often used when one feels embarrassed due to external circumstances (family member's actions, social status) rather than one's own direct wrongdoing. Implies a social dimension - feeling judged by others.

ANTONYM: ⟦{肩身|かたみ}が{広|ひろ}い→肩身が広い：30592_katamigahiroi⟧ (to feel proud, hold one's head high)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{居|い}づらい→居づらい：30593_izurai⟧ (uncomfortable to be somewhere)
- ⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧ (embarrassed) - more general
- ⟦{面目|めんぼく}→面目：09155_menboku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to lose face)
